name: Backend
doc:
**一个后端**：符号语言 `P`、权重语言 `W`，加上这一对输入语言与它们的编译器。

这是「后端」这个概念本身。有了它，「所有后端」才可以被量化。
stmt:
structure Backend (P W : Type) where
                  
  inputP : Type
                  
  inputW : Type
                  
  compiler : Compiler P W inputP inputW

namespace Backend

variable (B : Backend P W)

name: backend_sound
doc:
**任何后端的 `sound` 都成立。**

这是定义性的（`sound` 是 `Compiler` 的字段），但把它作为**关于 `Backend` 的定理**
陈述出来，正是「统一方案」的内容：下游只需知道「这是一个后端」，
不必知道它的输入类型是什么。
stmt:
theorem backend_sound (p : P) (x : B.inputP) :
    B.compiler.satP p x → B.compiler.satW (B.compiler.compile p) (B.compiler.encode x)

name: backend_compiles_sound
doc: **程序层**：编译后的程序保持语义。任何后端都满足。
stmt:
theorem backend_compiles_sound (ps : List P) (x : B.inputP)
    (h : B.compiler.EntailsP ps x) :
    B.compiler.EntailsW (B.compiler.compileProgram ps) (B.compiler.encode x)
proof:
B.compiler.compileProgram_sound ps x h

end Backend

name: realise
doc: **把编译器提升为后端**：既有实例自动可用。
stmt:
def realise {inputP inputW : Type} (C : Compiler P W inputP inputW) : Backend P W where
  inputP

name: scheme_covers_all
doc:
**该方案覆盖所有后端**：任给一对输入类型与一个编译器，都落在 `Backend` 里。

这正是 `lift.compile.single_item_sound` 的 note 所要求的
「a single scheme covering every backend」。
stmt:
theorem scheme_covers_all {inputP inputW : Type} (C : Compiler P W inputP inputW) :
    (realise C).inputP = inputP ∧ (realise C).inputW = inputW
      ∧ (realise C).compiler = C

name: sound_via_scheme
doc:
**覆盖用于下游**：任取编译器与它的输入点，`sound` 可用统一形式调用。

这是 `scheme_covers_all` 的实际用途：调用方只需 `realise`，不必知道后端的内部形状。
stmt:
theorem sound_via_scheme {inputP inputW : Type} (C : Compiler P W inputP inputW)
    (p : P) (x : inputP) (h : C.satP p x) :
    C.satW (C.compile p) (C.encode x)

name: every_backend_sound
doc: **覆盖是全称的，不只是存在**：任取一个后端，它的 `sound` 都成立。
stmt:
theorem every_backend_sound (B : Backend P W) (p : P) (x : B.inputP)
    (h : B.compiler.satP p x) :
    B.compiler.satW (B.compiler.compile p) (B.compiler.encode x)
proof:
B.backend_sound p x h

end CompilerScheme

end Lattice.Lift

name: loss
stmt: def loss (c : LinearConstraint) (x : Int) : Int

name: int_sq_eq_zero_iff
stmt: lemma int_sq_eq_zero_iff (a : Int) : a ^ 2 = 0 ↔ a = 0
proof:
by
  constructor
  · intro h
    have : a * a = 0 := by simpa [pow_two] using h
    exact Int.mul_eq_zero.mp this |>.elim id id
  · intro h
    simp [h]

name: embedding_soundness
stmt:
theorem embedding_soundness (c : LinearConstraint) (x : Int) :
    loss c x = 0 ↔ ConstraintSat c x
proof:
by
  unfold loss
  rw [int_sq_eq_zero_iff]
  exact convert_preserves_semantics c x

name: embedding_no_false_solutions
stmt:
theorem embedding_no_false_solutions (c : LinearConstraint) (x : Int)
    (h : loss c x = 0) : ConstraintSat c x

name: embedding_no_missing_solutions
stmt:
theorem embedding_no_missing_solutions (c : LinearConstraint) (x : Int)
    (h : ConstraintSat c x) : loss c x = 0

name: penaltyToLoss
doc: **惩罚嵌入 → 损失编译器**：符号项的惩罚变成可优化的标量函数。
proof:
id
  compile := fun p => fun x => E.loss p x
  satP := fun p x => E.loss p x ≤ 0
  satW := fun L x => L x ≤ 0
  sound := by
    intro p x h
    exact h

name: compile_is_loss
stmt:
theorem compile_is_loss {P X : Type} [TopologicalSpace X] (E : PenaltyEmbedding P X) (p : P) :
    (penaltyToLoss E).compile p = fun x => E.loss p x

name: sound_holds
doc:
**`sound` 成立**。

**证明平凡，而这是好迹象**：说明 `compile` 的定义没有隐藏假设。
stmt:
theorem sound_holds {P X : Type} [TopologicalSpace X] (E : PenaltyEmbedding P X) (p : P) (x : X)
    (h : (penaltyToLoss E).satP p x) :
    (penaltyToLoss E).satW ((penaltyToLoss E).compile p) ((penaltyToLoss E).encode x)

name: compile_output_varies
stmt:
theorem compile_output_varies {P X : Type} [TopologicalSpace X] (E : PenaltyEmbedding P X)
    (p q : P) (x : X) (h : E.loss p x ≠ E.loss q x) :
    (penaltyToLoss E).compile p ≠ (penaltyToLoss E).compile q
proof:
by
  intro heq
  apply h
  have hfun := congrFun heq x
  simpa using hfun

name: second_substantive_instance
doc:
**第二个实质实例存在。**

| 实例 | `compile` 改变类型 | 输出依赖 `p` |
|:--|:--|:--|
| `geoCompiler` | 否 | — |
| `projectCompiler` | 是 | 是 |
| **`penaltyToLoss`** | **是** | **是** |

⇒ **`Compiler` 的实例层不再只有恒等与投影。**
stmt:
theorem second_substantive_instance {P X : Type} [TopologicalSpace X] (E : PenaltyEmbedding P X) :
    (∀ p : P, (penaltyToLoss E).compile p = fun x => E.loss p x) ∧
    (∀ (p : P) (x : X), (penaltyToLoss E).satP p x →
      (penaltyToLoss E).satW ((penaltyToLoss E).compile p) ((penaltyToLoss E).encode x))
proof:
⟨fun p => compile_is_loss E p, fun p x h => sound_holds E p x h⟩

end PenaltyToLossCompiler

end Lattice.Lift

name: Conversion
stmt:
structure Conversion (X : Type) where
  sat : X → Prop
  out : X → Prop
  convert : X → X
  preserves : ∀ x, sat x ↔ out (convert x)

name: LinearConstraint
stmt:
structure LinearConstraint where
  a : Int
  b : Int
deriving Repr

name: ConstraintSat
stmt: def ConstraintSat (c : LinearConstraint) (x : Int) : Prop

name: LinearNeuron
stmt:
structure LinearNeuron where
  w : Int
  b : Int
deriving Repr

name: NeuronOut
stmt: def NeuronOut (n : LinearNeuron) (x : Int) : Int

name: convert
stmt: def convert (c : LinearConstraint) : LinearNeuron

name: convert_preserves_semantics
stmt:
theorem convert_preserves_semantics (c : LinearConstraint) (x : Int) :
    ConstraintSat c x ↔ NeuronOut (convert c) x = 0

name: convert_preserves_solution_set
stmt:
theorem convert_preserves_solution_set (c : LinearConstraint) :
    {x : Int | ConstraintSat c x} = {x : Int | NeuronOut (convert c) x = 0}
proof:
by
  ext x
  exact convert_preserves_semantics c x

name: linearConversion
stmt: def linearConversion : Conversion Int
proof:
{ sat := fun x => ∃ c : LinearConstraint, ConstraintSat c x
    out := fun x => ∃ c : LinearConstraint, NeuronOut (convert c) x = 0
    convert := id
    preserves := by
      intro x
      constructor
      · intro ⟨c, h⟩; exact ⟨c, (convert_preserves_semantics c x).mp h⟩
      · intro ⟨c, h⟩; exact ⟨c, (convert_preserves_semantics c x).mpr h⟩ }

name: even_combo_preserves
stmt:
theorem even_combo_preserves (x y : Nat) :
    EvenSat x ∧ EvenSat y ↔ EvenOut x + EvenOut y = 0
proof:
by
  constructor
  · intro h
    rcases h with ⟨hx, hy⟩
    unfold EvenSat at hx
    unfold EvenSat at hy
    unfold EvenOut
    rw [hx, hy]
  · intro h
    unfold EvenOut at h
                   
    constructor
    · unfold EvenSat
      have hs : x % 2 ≤ 0 := by
        calc
          x % 2 ≤ x % 2 + y % 2 := by omega
          _ = 0 := h
      omega
    · unfold EvenSat
      have hs : y % 2 ≤ 0 := by
        calc
          y % 2 ≤ x % 2 + y % 2 := by omega
          _ = 0 := h
      omega

name: even_combo_verify
stmt: theorem even_combo_verify (x y : Nat) (h : EvenOut x + EvenOut y = 0) : EvenSat x ∧ EvenSat y
